Foreign Body Granuloma: F13: Bacterial and fungal stains (Ziehl–Neelsen and Grocott) were negative
F2: Chief complaint: painless, firm area of induration and mild erythema below left lower eyelid
F5: History: dacryocystorhinostomy one month before lesion onset
F6: Mass persisted despite two courses of antibiotics for presumed postoperative cellulitis
F8: Examination finding: focal, non-tender, indurated elevation along inferior orbital rim
F10: Intraoperative frozen sections revealed granulomatous inflammation
F11: Final histopathology: granulomatous inflammation with central necrobiosis, extensive Alcian-Blue positive mucin, and scattered multinucleated giant cells
